description:
Today, a wonderful Yoga session for the Interactors of Kapol Vidyanidhi School was successfully conducted at 9:30 am by our very own Rotary Ann Chaitali Prabhu.

The session encouraged students to embrace the importance of fitness, mindfulness and a healthy lifestyle. Thank you, Chaitali, for inspiring our young Interactors with your time and expertise.

Kudos to the Interact team for this meaningful initiative
